literal: To the bright forehead, oh!, it broke indeed, in battle even foes fear, my pride.
translation: My great pride, which terrifies even my enemies on the battlefield, has shattered before her bright forehead. Oh!
modern: போர்க்களத்தில் பகைவரும் கண்டு அஞ்சுகின்ற என்னுடைய வீரப்பெருமை, இவளுடைய ஒளிபொருந்திய நெற்றியைக் கண்டதும் உடைந்துவிட்டதே!
explanation: The hero marvels at the overwhelming power of the heroine's beauty. He is a fierce warrior whose strength and pride ('பீடு') strike terror into his enemies on the battlefield ('ஞாட்பு'). Yet, that very same unshakeable pride has completely shattered before her radiant forehead ('ஒண்ணுதல்'). The exclamation 'ஓஒ' expresses his helpless astonishment at how easily love has conquered his martial valor.
